posts.text: "If Marco Rubio is the nominee for President, [Democrats] are in trouble," @RubenGallego says at @TheLatino_Vote summit when @madrid_mike asks Gallego about 2028.
posts.summary: Rubio candidacy poses challenge to Democratic coalition

posts.text: "There is no national party without  Latinos," @RubenGallego says about Democrats. You need to meet them where they are at, he notes, and not where you want them to be. The Obama Latino support years have passed. #LVS2026
